description:
Cast Draconic Visitor by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Draconic Visitor enters, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a number of 5/5 Dragon creature tokens with flying due to Draconic Visitor. 
When the Dragons enter, Terror of the Peaks triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage to Smaug.
Repeat from step 3.
